data.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Jeromy comes from the Hebrew words ‘Yerach’ meaning ‘God’ and ‘Yamim’ meaning ‘days’. This name was given to children born on the day the Lord showed His power and might. It was also a name given to those who were raised up by God to lead and serve.
